name: Simple AVS (Age Verification)
description: A cookie/session-based age-verification gate. NOTE: advisory only — not real access control.
project_description:
Simple AVS is a light weight cookie/ session based Age Verification System. It's meant to allow sites to maintain age restrictions on content. This does not replace systems requirements for strict age verification for content. It is a "bare minimum" approach.

 Features 
 There are two types of age verification methods that can be used: 

 
 A simple Yes/ No Question of: Are you over the age of (insert configurable age here) 
 Users can enter their date of birth 
 
 A minimum age can be set- whether it's 18+ or 21+, or any arbitrary number, the frequency that the modal will show up, and what pages you want to include or exclude. You can set redirects for both success (over the expected age) and failures (underage viewers). You can also set the text you want to show up on various labels and buttons, and either use one of the preset color schemes or use the color picker to design your own through the UI. 

 Permissions include the ability to set rights for roles who can configure the module and roles that may skip seeing the modal.

 Post-Installation 
 To configure this module go to: /admin/config/simpleavs. The configuration is relatively simple and intuitive. To test, set the prompt frequency to "On Every Page Load" and open up a new browser windows as an anon user. It defaults to showing up on the front page. 

 Additional Requirements 
 Nope. This is meant to be a light weight module.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 This project is pretty self explanatory and stand alone. Not much to see here. It does what it does.

 Similar projects 
 There's the Age Verification Module, but it never got ported to D10 and it appears to not have been touched in a couple of years. This module is more flexible in the type of age verification used on the page and adds more configuration options, while still being light weight.
